title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
content: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterm elections for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primary elections.

title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
content: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.

title: Takeaways from the Trump-Xi state visit: Pageantry and pandas
content: The visit comes at an important time for both men.

title: Woman who accused Jay-Z of sexual assault says her claims were false
content: On Thursday, the woman identified as Jane Doe filed a declaration in Manhattan federal court stating that all of her original claims against the rapper were false.

title: There's a global pandemic treaty that's signed -- and in 'limbo.' What's the holdup?
content: The treaty aims to help the countries of the world prepare for — and defeat — any future pandemic. Why hasn't it gone into effect?

title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
content: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

title: Pope Leo warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity on his France visit
content: Pope Leo XIV raised existential concerns about scientific progress, life and human rights during a speech on his first papal visit to France.

title: Hurricane Nolo, a zig-zagging storm, threatens Hawaii with flooding rains
content: Nolo will slow down as it nears Hawaii's Big Island and is expected to become a major hurricane this weekend, bringing torrential rain to areas that have been flooded by big storms this summer.

title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit. And, Netanyahu gives defiant UNGA speech
content: Trump and Xi's U.S. summit continues after a state dinner Thursday night. And, Netanyahu returns to Israel after giving a defensive and defiant speech at the U.N. General Assembly.

title: Why this Pokémon set is dropping in value
content: How does one price a cemetery plot? Are they using dynamic pricing to figure it out? We tackle that question and many more in this week's Indicator newsletter.
